# Tony Repo 2026.10.1

Tony Repo is tony's personal APT source for original jailbreak hacks, fixes,
tools, and experiments. The packages in this release target iOS/iPadOS
16 rootless jailbreaks.

## Add the source

```text
https://widmonstertony.github.io/tonyrepo/
```

- [Add to Sileo](sileo://source/https://widmonstertony.github.io/tonyrepo/)
- [Add to Zebra](zbra://sources/add/https://widmonstertony.github.io/tonyrepo/)

Refresh sources after adding it, then search for the package name.

## Packages currently available directly from the source

- **ThermalLightControl 3.3.0** — iPadOS 16 thermal brightness-cap control with CPU/GPU throttling and emergency protections preserved.
- **VirtualMac Audio Stability Fix 1.0.1** — iPadOS 16.1 MediaExperience/Now Playing teardown-race mitigation.

## NewT66y 2.3.7 local builder

This release also includes the open-source local package builder. It contains no
NewT66y IPA, app bundle, icon, signature, or generated package. A user must
provide a lawfully obtained `1024app_ios_2.3.7.ipa` on their own Mac; the tool
then creates a rootless `.deb` for local installation on their own device.

Download `TonyRepo-NewT66y-Local-Builder-v1.0.0.zip`, verify it against
`SHA256SUMS.txt`, extract it, and read the included `README.md`.

## 中文说明

Tony Repo 是适用于 iOS/iPadOS 16 rootless 越狱环境的 APT 软件源。把下面地址
添加到 Sileo 或 Zebra，刷新软件源后即可搜索并安装已经发布的插件：

```text
https://widmonstertony.github.io/tonyrepo/
```

本 Release 同时提供 NewT66y 2.3.7 本地打包工具，但不包含小草 IPA、App、图标、
签名或生成后的安装包。用户必须在自己的 Mac 上提供自己合法取得的 IPA，并且只能
把生成结果安装到自己的设备。

## Integrity

Verify the downloadable builder archive with the SHA-256 value in
`SHA256SUMS.txt`. The tag and release notes do not grant rights to any
third-party application or content.
